spans.s: SNIFF: v. To inhale, snuff, smell.

SNIP (v.):
I Lit.: अग्रं
or
अग्रभागं छिनत्ति (छिद्,
c. 7.): v. To cut, tap.
II To pilfer:
q. v.: मुष्णाति (मुष्, c. 9.).

SNIVEL (v.):
I To run at the nose: expr.
by मलं स्रवति (स्रु, c. 1.: with abl. of nose),
s. ing:
नासास्रवः, Sr.
II Whine: क्रन्दति (क्रन्द्,
c. 1.): v. To cry.
